"• Ported to the latest Android SDK version • Improved displaying of hieroglyphs • A new hieroglyph sign list showing all available hieroglyphs • Various minor fixes and updates"

Exact match:" The search results contain exactly the search string you entered. No hieroglyphs or characters can follow or precede the search the string. "Prefix match:" Other hieroglyphs or characters may follow the search string in the search results. "Substring match: Other hieroglyphs or characters may precede or follow the search string in the search results. This is the default setting." "In-order match:" Other hieroglyphs may precede, follow or stand in between the hieroglyphs of the search string. "Any-order match:" The search results contain the hieroglyphs of the search string in any order.
Often, the option \"substring match\" will return the desired results. By choosing \"exact match\" or \"prefix match\" you can restrict the amount of results. You can also cast a wider net and get more diverse results by using \"in-order match\" or \"any-order match\" (these options only apply when searching for hieroglyphs).
Search results always include matches with variants of the hieroglyphs (Gardiner codes with a letter after the number) in the search string, except for specific variants of a hieroglyph that are specified in the search string. "

The app supports the display of multiple commonly used transliteration methods. However, the different transliteration methods cannot always be converted into each other perfectly. Particularly the letters ἰ, j and y are used in different ways. Internally, the app uses the Gardiner scheme. (You can enter transliterations in any way you like, independently of this setting.)

"You can search for hieroglyphs, transliterations and English translations. Choose the corresponding icon in the title bar menu to switch to the desired search mode. "Searching for hieroglyphs:" There are three different keyboards for entering hieroglyphs: by transliteration, by Gardiner Code and by browsing through the list. You can select the different keyboards by swiping left or right over the keyboard or by tapping on the keyboard title. (Keys that are not applicable are shown as faded out.) When you see the hieroglyph you are looking for, tap on it to add it to your search string. On the transliteration keyboard, when you long-press on a key, it will enter the corresponding uniliteral hieroglyph directly. (When you long-press on a hieroglyph directly, more information will be shown about it.) Press on the backspace key to undo your last action. When you have entered the hieroglyphs you want to search for, tap on the search key to show the search results. "Searching for transliterations:" Enter the transliteration you are looking for and tap the search icon to show the search results. While you are typing, the screen will start showing dictionary entries starting with what you typed. You can tap on one of the options shown to immediately show the results for that entry. "Searching for English translations: Type the text you are looking for and then tap the search icon to display the results.

"This app includes the following third-party components:
• SqliteRE (Regex-Encryption) from https://github.com/mobi-life/sqlitere • sqlite3 (public domain) • sqlite3-pcre (public domain) from http://git.altlinux.org/people/at/packages/?p=sqlite3-pcre.git • PCRE 8.37 (BSD 3-clause) • Android native and java helper classes: https://sqlite.org/android/doc/trunk/www/index.wiki • Encryption Module from https://github.com/rindeal/SQLite3-Encryption"
